1.world_description:
Turn MetaMath proofs into Archipelago worlds!
Each proof step is both a location (proving it) and an item (ability to use it).
Navigate logical dependencies across the multiworld to complete your proof.

2.label: eleq2
2.full_text: eleq2: Equality implies equivalence of membership.  (Contributed by NM, 26-May-1993.)  (Proof shortened by Wolf Lammen, 20-Nov-2019.)

3.label: fofn
3.expression: |- ( F : A -onto-> B -> F Fn A )
3.full_text: fofn: An onto mapping is a function on its domain.  (Contributed by NM, 16-Dec-2008.)
3.instantiated_expression: |- ( F : A -onto-> ~P A -> F Fn A )

4.label: forn
4.expression: |- ( F : A -onto-> B -> ran F = B )
4.full_text: forn: The codomain of an onto function is its range.  (Contributed by NM, 3-Aug-1994.)
4.instantiated_expression: |- ( F : A -onto-> ~P A -> ran F = ~P A )

5.label: fvelrnb
5.expression: |- ( F Fn A -> ( B e. ran F <-> E. x e. A ( F ` x ) = B ) )
5.full_text: fvelrnb: A member of a function's range is a value of the function.  (Contributed by NM, 31-Oct-1995.)
5.instantiated_expression: |- ( F Fn A -> ( { x e. A | -. x e. ( F ` x ) } e. ran F <-> E. y e. A ( F ` y ) = { x e. A | -. x e. ( F ` x ) } ) )

6.label: fveq2
6.full_text: fveq2: Equality theorem for function value.  (Contributed by NM, 29-Dec-1996.)

7.label: id
7.full_text: id: Principle of identity.  Theorem *2.08 of [WhiteheadRussell] p. 101.  For another version of the proof directly from axioms, see ~ idALT .  Its associated inference, ~ idi , requires no axioms for its proof, contrary to ~ id .  Note that the second occurrences of ` ph ` in Steps 1 and 2 may be simultaneously replaced by any wff ` ps ` , which may ease the understanding of the proof.  (Contributed by NM, 29-Dec-1992.)  (Proof shortened by Stefan Allan, 20-Mar-2006.)

8.label: eleq12d
8.full_text: eleq12d: Theorem eleq12i is the congruence law for elementhood. $) $( $j congruence 'eleq12i'; $) $} $} ${ eleq12d.1 $e |- ( ph -> A = B ) $. eleq12d.2 $e |- ( ph -> C = D ) $. $( Deduction from equality to equivalence of membership.  (Contributed by NM, 31-May-1994.)

9.label: nbbn
9.full_text: nbbn: Move negation outside of biconditional.  Compare Theorem *5.18 of [WhiteheadRussell] p. 124.  (Contributed by NM, 27-Jun-2002.)  (Proof shortened by Wolf Lammen, 20-Sep-2013.)  (Proof shortened by Umit Teoman Dogan, 10-Jun-2026.)

10.label: notbid
10.full_text: notbid: Deduction negating both sides of a logical equivalence.  (Contributed by NM, 21-May-1994.)

11.label: elrab
11.expression: |- ( A e. { x e. B | ph } <-> ( A e. B /\ ps ) )
11.full_text: elrab: Membership in a restricted class abstraction, using implicit substitution.  (Contributed by NM, 21-May-1999.)  Remove dependency on ~ ax-13 .  (Revised by Steven Nguyen, 23-Nov-2022.)

12.label: baibr
12.full_text: baibr: Move conjunction outside of biconditional.  (Contributed by NM, 11-Jul-1994.)

13.label: ssrab2
13.expression: |- { x e. A | ph } C_ A
13.full_text: ssrab2: Subclass relation for a restricted class.  (Contributed by NM, 19-Mar-1997.)  (Proof shortened by BJ and SN, 8-Aug-2024.)
13.instantiated_expression: |- { x e. A | -. x e. ( F ` x ) } C_ A

14.label: elpwi2
14.full_text: elpwi2: Membership in a power class.  (Contributed by Glauco Siliprandi, 3-Mar-2021.)  (Proof shortened by Wolf Lammen, 26-May-2024.)
14.instantiated_expression: |- { x e. A | -. x e. ( F ` x ) } e. ~P A

15.label: eleqtrrid
15.full_text: eleqtrrid: A membership and equality inference.  (Contributed by NM, 4-Jan-2006.)
15.instantiated_expression: |- ( F : A -onto-> ~P A -> { x e. A | -. x e. ( F ` x ) } e. ran F )

16.label: syl
16.full_text: syl: An inference version of the transitive laws for implication ~ imim2 and ~ imim1 (and ~ imim1i and ~ imim2i ), which Russell and Whitehead call "the principle of the syllogism ... because ... the syllogism in Barbara [[ ~ barbara ] is derived from [[ ~ syl ]" (quote after Theorem *2.06 of [WhiteheadRussell] p. 101).  Some authors call this law a "hypothetical syllogism".  Its associated inference is ~ mp2b . (A bit of trivia: this is the most commonly referenced assertion in our database (13449 times as of 22-Jul-2021).  In second place is ~ eqid (9597 times), followed by ~ adantr (8861 times), ~ syl2anc (7421 times), ~ adantl (6403 times), and ~ simpr (5829 times).  The Metamath program command 'show usage' shows the number of references.) 20-Oct-2011.)  (Proof shortened by Wolf Lammen, 26-Jul-2012.)
16.instantiated_expression: |- ( F : A -onto-> ~P A -> ( { x e. A | -. x e. ( F ` x ) } e. ran F <-> E. y e. A ( F ` y ) = { x e. A | -. x e. ( F ` x ) } ) )

17.label: sylib
17.full_text: sylib: A mixed syllogism inference from an implication and a biconditional.

18.label: nsyl
18.full_text: nsyl: A negated syllogism inference.  (Contributed by NM, 31-Dec-1993.) (Proof shortened by Wolf Lammen, 2-Mar-2013.)

19.label: nrex
19.full_text: nrex: Inference adding restricted existential quantifier to negated wff.

20.label: mtbiri
20.full_text: mtbiri: An inference from a biconditional, similar to modus tollens.
20.instantiated_expression: |- ( F : A -onto-> ~P A -> -. { x e. A | -. x e. ( F ` x ) } e. ran F )

21.label: pm2.65i
21.full_text: pm2.65i: Inference for proof by contradiction.  (Contributed by NM, 18-May-1994.) (Proof shortened by Wolf Lammen, 11-Sep-2013.)  (Proof shortened by Garrett Katz, 7-Jun-2026.)
